basis: The dashboard shows May grid energy use as a thin sliver near the baseline, visually below the lowest y-axis tick of 10,000 kWh. In contrast, the next lowest month (Jun) is approximately 17,500 kWh, and other months range up to 40,000 kWh. This represents an extreme deviation (a drop of over 50% from the next lowest value) that falls outside the normal operating range depicted on the chart. In the context of energy operations monitoring, such an isolated, extreme low value is indicative of a critical anomaly (e.g., meter failure or grid disconnect) rather than a standard low-usage case.
option_label: Escalate May to critical low-usage anomaly review
